name.en: Membrane roof, mounts welded or fastened through TPO or PVC cover membrane
name.es: Cubierta de membrana, soportes soldados o fijados a través de membrana TPO o PVC

description.en: Mount fixed through a hot-air welded TPO or PVC cover membrane into the deck or purlin, with the membrane sealed by weld. Source is a rooftop equipment mount (GAF RM240), used only as the membrane-attachment reference; it is not a PV rack. EPDM and fully adhered (no penetration) systems not covered.
description.es: Soporte fijado a través de una membrana de cubierta TPO o PVC soldada con aire caliente a la lámina de la cubierta. La fuente es un soporte de equipos de cubierta (GAF RM240), usado solo como referencia de fijación sobre membrana; no es un bastidor fotovoltaico. No cubre EPDM ni sistemas totalmente adheridos sin penetración.

typical_use: Membrane (TPO or PVC) flat or low-slope roofs where ballast load is not acceptable. Attachment design, fastener count and roof warranty conditions are set by the design professional.

materials.material: TPO or PVC (hot-air weldable); EPDM not covered by source
Drill-Tec series fasteners (material and grade not stated)

geometry.description: Mount dimensions and fastener layout not stated in the source. No elements placed.

accessories.name: Rooftop equipment mount 240 (membrane attachment reference)

quantity.note: Number of mounts and fasteners per mount set by the design professional (source header). 0 means unknown.

accessories.purpose: Attaches equipment to the membrane; used as attachment reference only

accessories.name: Drill-Tec #14, Drill-Tec XHD (#15) or Drill-Tec purlin fastener (per design)

quantity.note: Count per mount set by design professional. Length not stated.

accessories.purpose: Fixes the mount through the membrane to the deck or purlin

accessories.name: Connection nut on membrane mount
accessories.note: Range 20 to 25 lbf-ft = 27.1 to 33.9 Nm; lower bound stored. Excess torque may damage the mount (source body text). Use calibrated wrench.

accessories.name: Hot-air weld of cover membrane perimeter

quantity.note: Perimeter of each mount; length not stated.

accessories.purpose: Seals the cover membrane around the mount
accessories.note: Minimum 2 in (50.8 mm) weld around the perimeter with a 2 in roller; probe the seam to confirm (source step 4).

grounding_bonding: Not found for membrane-attached PV mounts in the GAF source.
installation_notes: Hot-air weld the cover membrane perimeter; probe the seam (GAF source step 4). Fasteners are per design professional.
